pet.name: Caniton
pet.desc: A toxic hound whose drool eats through steel.

pet.name: Pigale
pet.desc: Its fluffy wool traps gusts of wind that it lets loose in a single burst.

pet.name: Tropigust
pet.desc: Tropigust rides warm island breezes and never lands for long.

pet.name: Dangler
pet.desc: The light on its lure is the last thing its prey ever sees.

pet.name: Thermant
pet.desc: A tiny ant that burns hot enough to melt sand into glass.

pet.name: Armordillo
pet.desc: Sworn to protect its friends, it never takes off its armor.

pet.name: Macrobe
pet.desc: A giant microbe that feeds on stray static charge.

pet.name: Batawoc
pet.desc: It sleeps in skulls and wakes up hungry.

pet.name: Penzai
pet.desc: An ancient stone guardian that has grown a garden on its back.

pet.name: Bumblebeam
pet.desc: Its glowing abdomen lights up the hive at night.

pet.name: Cap'n Skelly
pet.desc: The captain went down with the ship, and came back up again.

pet.name: Cocon
pet.desc: A coconut that trained in the art of stealth. Mostly it just falls on people.

pet.name: Drakitton
pet.desc: Playful as a kitten, fierce as a dragon.

pet.name: Hartwood
pet.desc: Carved from driftwood by the tide, it roams the shore at dawn.

pet.name: Ducan
pet.desc: Ducans have trouble swimming and rely on their special gear to swim long distances.

pet.name: Claymore
pet.desc: Handle with care. Claymore has a very short fuse.

pet.name: Flairy
pet.desc: A spark of sunlight that learned how to giggle.

pet.name: Clawsphorus
pet.desc: Its shell glows red hot whenever it gets angry, which is often.

pet.name: Impkin
pet.desc: A mischievous little flame that loves to play tricks.

pet.name: Rosie
pet.desc: Beautiful to look at, painful to pick.

pet.name: Frochkon
pet.desc: Nobody knows which kingdom it rules, including the frog itself.

pet.name: Mander
pet.desc: It sheds its skin in a puff of smoke.

pet.name: Gryphos
pet.desc: A noble sky hunter that answers only to the brave.

pet.name: Gumley
pet.desc: Gumley is composed of intelligent polysaccharides that fused together to create a unified consciousness.

pet.name: Hydragon
pet.desc: The Hydragon's heads can't seem to cooperate with one another unless they're in combat.

pet.name: Vultaire
pet.desc: It circles over frozen peaks waiting for the wind to change.

pet.name: Jack
pet.desc: Its grin burns brighter every night of the harvest.

pet.name: Jellot
pet.desc: Under that coy smile lies an insidious curio with clandestine intent.

pet.name: Thundiger
pet.desc: Its mane crackles with lightning before every pounce.

pet.name: Magmo
pet.desc: A walking furnace built around a molten heart.

pet.name: Mantank
pet.desc: Half mantis, half artillery, all business.

pet.name: Yeteen
pet.desc: A young yeti whose fur reflects the glow of the northern lights.

pet.name: Pelica
pet.desc: It carries messages, snacks and the occasional lost curio in its beak.

pet.name: Penstripe
pet.desc: Always dressed for the occasion, even underwater.

pet.name: Jawroger
pet.desc: The terror of the seven seas, and of the local fish market.

pet.name: Pottor
pet.desc: It hides inside its pot and peeks out only to fight.

pet.name: Toadstone
pet.desc: Moss grows on its back because it rarely moves.

pet.name: Prismo
pet.desc: It splits sunlight into rainbows, and enemies into pieces.

pet.name: Pupette
pet.desc: A forgotten doll stitched together with a stubborn will.

pet.name: Ossilis
pet.desc: Its shell is harder than the rocks it sleeps under.

pet.name: Shado
pet.desc: It is always right behind you.

pet.name: Cathode
pet.desc: It sings during thunderstorms, and the storms sing back.

pet.name: Tiki
pet.desc: An ancient mask that dances around the island bonfires.

pet.name: Nightmaroot
pet.desc: Pulled from the ground at midnight, it has been cranky ever since.

pet.name: Chelydra
pet.desc: Slow, patient and absolutely impossible to move.

pet.name: Wormseed
pet.desc: Don't take a bite. It bites back.
